pageHeadHtml:
Grants & Funding

Selected programmes are grouped by my role. Award amounts are included only where they are already public in the linked source or institutional announcement.
pageBodyHtml:
Principal Investigator

  • 2026 — DST–A*STAR India–Singapore Joint Science and Technology Research Programme. Three-year programme on indigenous radiology datasets and culturally congruent vision-language models. Institutional announcement →
  • 2026 — IndiaAI Cancer AI and Technology Challenge, PREDICT-AI. Consortium with the Koita Centre for Digital Health at Ashoka University, Tata Memorial Hospital and Manentia AI. Institutional announcement →

Programme team supervision

  • 2025 — PrAImaan, Gates Foundation-supported. Clinical Research and Technical Teams Supervisor under PI Prof. Anurag Agrawal. Formal commitment: US$972,192. Grant record →
  • 2025 — V2DD, Gates Foundation-supported. Clinical Evaluation Team Supervisor under PI Prof. Anurag Agrawal. Formal commitment: US$383,295. Grant record →

Earlier research support

  • 2022–2025 — TIH iHub Drishti, AIIMS New Delhi × IIT Jodhpur. Investigator for the rib-fracture AI project developed through my MD thesis. iHub Drishti →
  • 2018 — ICMR Short-Term Studentship. Student Investigator at JIPMER for work on normative arterial-stiffness indices. ICMR STS →
